articles.title: Trader loses $1M after signing phishing token approval
articles.snippet: Onchain scammers netted more than $14 billion last year, and approval phishing remains a primary attack vector.

articles.title: Solana Meme Coin Bonk Treasury Drained of $20 Million in 'Malicious' Governance Attack
